image_description: A vintage manual typewriter, likely an Olivetti, viewed from a high angle. The machine features a dark green metal body, a black platen with the brand name 'OLIVETTI' in white text, and a keyboard with round, glass-topped keys. The space bar is the long, horizontal lever located at the bottom center of the keyboard assembly.
